title: Meta-Labeling & Ranker Report

policies.POLICY_C_RISK_ADJUSTED: meta_label=1 if net_return > min AND mae > mae_limit

meta_label_framework.stacking_leakage_enforcement: build_meta_labels(require_oos=True) raises RuntimeError on in-sample predictions
meta_label_framework.outcome_feature_guard: validate_no_outcome_features() raises ValueError if outcome columns appear in feature list
meta_label_framework.outcome_prefix_safety: DataFrame output uses _outcome_ prefix on all target-derived columns

class_imbalance.policy: is_unbalance=True in LightGBM; scale_pos_weight in XGBoost

note: ML_ADDS_NO_CLEAR_VALUE logic implemented in compare_meta_models(). Will be evaluated when real data is available.
